name: agentflow
description: Shared native xMind agent sessions and coding workflows in VS Code.

commands.title: xMind: Add Opened Folder to Workspace

viewsWelcome.contents: Refresh to view Git changes from the opened workspace. Status comes from the shared native xMind backend. [Refresh](command:agentflow.refreshGitChanges)

agentflow.backendMode.description: Managed connects the opened folder to its shared native local profile through a native view adapter. Console and editor share backend execution and SQLite. External attaches to an explicitly configured matching workspace.

agentflow.runtimeDirectory.description: Optional absolute directory containing a verified xMind native-runtime-manifest.json. Defaults to the extension's bundled runtime.

agentflow.stdlibSource.description: Optional trusted machine-level pure standard-library directory for a development native runtime.

agentflow.profileRoot.description: Optional absolute local xMind profile directory shared with the webpage or console. Defaults to the per-user .xMind/p directory. Keep it outside opened workspaces.

agentflow.openOnStartup.description: Open the xMind sidebar and connect to the active workspace when VS Code starts.

agentflow.providerConfigPath.description: Optional absolute path overriding the provider YAML file. Development installs automatically use the repository .config/providers.yaml when present; opened workspace folders are never searched.

agentflow.languageServerConfigPath.description: Optional absolute path to trusted native language-server profiles. Development installs automatically use the repository .config/language-servers.yaml when present; opened workspace folders are never searched.

agentflow.processConfigPath.description: Optional absolute path to trusted native process profiles. Development installs automatically use the repository .config/processes.yaml when present; opened workspaces are never searched. Run xMind: Apply Trusted Runtime Configuration after changing it.

agentflow.workspaceEdits.description: Enable native approval-based file proposals in new managed profiles. False selects an initial read-only profile; existing profiles retain their native policy.

agentflow.backendUrl.description: Explicit external native xMind Server origin used only in external mode. Its workspace must match the selected folder; authentication is stored separately in SecretStorage.
